CARRY RESOLVED: the havraa freeze-and-reduction hora'at sha'a was NOT renewed. Both laws expired with tax year 2025 and are not in force for 2026. Step 2.6 now states this outright AND notes the step is still live work, because the 2024/2025 returns are exactly what gets filed during 2026. Read the step as scoped to the return's tax YEAR, not the filing year.

BRACKETS VERIFIED, NOT CHANGED. A secondary source (a tax-advisor blog) gave materially different 2026 brackets (3rd band ending 193,800, surtax threshold 765,390). The ITA's own monthly deductions booklet, extracted with pdftotext, confirms the skill: 20% to 228,000, 31% to 301,200, 35% to 560,280, 3% surtax above 721,560 under s.121B. The 2025 booklet lacks 228,000/301,200, so brackets 3-5 genuinely did widen for 2026, and the 2026 booklet is marked 'updated April 2026', consistent with Amendment 288 approved 31 March 2026. LESSON: do not 'correct' a table against a blog; go to the ITA PDF.

An agent routed to the reference for 'any tax calculation' would have taxed income above the threshold at the surtax rate instead of 47%+3%, under-reporting by 44 points on every shekel above it. Both the table and a warning paragraph are fixed.

Added the combined-total trap explicitly: the floor applies to the year's total across Section 46 institutions, not per donation. Four 60 NIS donations qualify; checking them one at a time wrongly disqualifies the claim.
